'''Eugene Irving Gordon ''' (September 14, 1930 – September 15, 2014) was an American [[physicist]].  He was Director of the Lightwave Devices Laboratory of [[Bell Labs]].

==Biography==
Gordon was born on September 14, 1930, in [[New York City]]. He graduated from the [[City College of New York]] in 1952 with a B.S. in physics, and completed his Ph.D. from the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]] in 1957.<ref name=IEEE>{{cite web|title=Eugene I. Gordon|url=http://www.ieeeghn.org/wiki/index.php/Eugene_I._Gordon|website=GHN - IEEE Global History Network|accessdate=16 September 2014}}</ref> He became director of the Lightwave Devices Laboratory of [[Bell Labs]]. He married Renate Albrecht on December 31, 1991. He died on September 15, 2014, in [[Scotch Plains, New Jersey]].<ref name=StarLedger>{{cite web|url=http://obits.nj.com/obituaries/starledger/obituary.aspx?pid=172476312|title=Eugene I. Gordon|website=The Star Ledger|accessdate=16 September 2014}}</ref>

==Honors and awards==
* IEEE [[Edison Medal]] in 1984<ref>[http://www.ieeeghn.org/wiki/index.php/Eugene_I._Gordon IEEE History Center biography]</ref> 
* member, [[National Academy of Engineering]] in 1978<ref>[http://www.nae.edu/nae/naepub.nsf/Members+By+UNID/918886A30A8F319985256FFC004A428A?opendocument NAE] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081024051713/http://www.nae.edu/nae/naepub.nsf/Members+By+UNID/918886A30A8F319985256FFC004A428A?opendocument |date=2008-10-24 }}</ref>
* IEEE Vladimir K. Zworykin Award in 1975<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20070515194648/http://www.ieee.org/portal/pages/about/awards/pr/zworkpr.html List of IEEE Vladimir K. Zworykin Award recipients]</ref> 
* Fellow, [[IEEE]] 1968
